description: This file defines the 'Xlsx' class, a PHP class responsible for writing spreadsheets in the XLSX format within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles creation of the compression archive, references multiple components for styles, drawings, relationships, and various parts of the XLSX structure, and manages the process of serializing spreadsheet data, styles, and media into the appropriate XML files encapsulated in a ZIP archive.

classes.name: Xlsx
classes.description: The Xlsx class handles writing spreadsheets to the XLSX format, including managing parts of the archive, styles, media, relationships, and serialization of spreadsheet data into XML files inside a ZIP archive.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes the Spreadsheet object into an XLSX ZIP archive and saves to the specified filename, handling creation of all necessary parts and media.

methods.name: setSpreadsheet
methods.description: Sets the Spreadsheet object to be written.
